hero.headlinePre: Your business doesn't need more software.
hero.subhead: An Odoo ERP and web development studio for companies that are done with patchwork tools and templated websites.

odoo.title: One system to run the whole business.
odoo.body: We implement, customise, and own the result. From discovery to go-live to the year-two roadmap — your ERP is our craft, not a side project.

web.title: Sites and platforms built for one company — because they were.
web.body: Bespoke marketing sites, internal tools, customer portals. Designed and engineered together, never templated, never outsourced.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.body: We map the actual workflow before we touch a single tool.

design.title: Design
design.body: Architecture, data model, interface — designed together.

build.title: Build
build.body: We build it. Not a freelancer pool. Us.

shift.title: Shift
shift.body: Migration, training, handover. The shift lands.

cta.heading: Ready when you are.
cta.body: Tell us where the friction is. We'll come back with the shape of the shift.

about.heading: We work on systems, not just screens.
about.intro: Coshift was started in M'Sila, Algeria, by people who've been on both sides of a bad ERP rollout — and the good kind. The studio exists to make the second kind the default.

ownership.title: We own the result.
ownership.body: From the first workshop to the second-year roadmap, the same team stays on the line.

craft.title: Craft over throughput.
craft.body: We do fewer engagements than we could. The ones we take, we ship at studio quality.

fluency.title: Bilingual, fluent in business.
fluency.body: We speak French, English, and the language of margins, lead times, and inventory turns.

location.heading: Where we are.
location.body: Based in M'Sila, Algeria. Working with teams across the Maghreb, Francophone Africa, Europe, and the Gulf.

odoo.heading: One system. The whole business.
odoo.intro: We design, build, and operate Odoo ERPs for companies that are done duct-taping spreadsheets, legacy systems, and SaaS tools that don't talk to each other.

deliverables.heading: What you get
items: Discovery and workflow mapping (no demo decks)
Module selection, configuration, and custom development
User training in French, English, or Arabic
Go-live support and a 90-day stabilisation window
A 12-month roadmap and an SLA you can hold us to

items.a: Both. We recommend based on your modules and scale. Enterprise pays for itself fast above a certain headcount; Community is right for many lean operations. We say which on day one.

items.q: How long does an implementation take?
items.a: A focused mid-size implementation lands in 8 to 16 weeks. Multi-entity, multi-country rollouts run longer. We give you a hard timeline after Discover, not before.

items.q: Can you migrate us from another ERP?
items.a: Yes. SAP Business One, Sage, Dolibarr, and home-grown systems are routine. The data work is the unglamorous part of the job — we own it.
Odoo.sh, OVH, AWS, on-premise — your call. We have an opinion and we'll share it.

web.heading: Bespoke web. Not templates with paint.
web.intro: Marketing sites, internal tools, customer portals, and product surfaces. Engineered like software, designed like editorial.

deliverables.heading: What you get
items: Brand-aligned design system, not a Figma kit graveyard
Headless CMS or MDX content layer, whichever fits
Bilingual content support from day one
Analytics, A/B-test scaffolding, and a launch playbook
Six-month post-launch retainer if you want one

items.q: Do you do design and engineering, or just one?
items.a: Both, in the same room. We don't accept hand-offs we didn't shape; we don't ship designs we can't build.

items.q: Will the site we get look like this one?
items.a: No. Your site looks like your company. This one looks like ours.

items.q: Can you work with our existing brand?
items.a: Yes. We've taken brand systems from polished guideline PDFs to functional component libraries dozens of times.
A 90-day stabilisation is standard. Retainers from there are optional and scoped to actual needs.

work.heading: The shifts we've shipped.
work.intro: A small, opinionated selection. Each one is the version of itself we'd be happy to defend.

lab.heading: Things we build to stay sharp.
lab.intro: Quick experiments, motion studies, and tooling we publish so the team — and you — can see the workshop floor.

contact.heading: Tell us about the shift.
contact.intro: The clearer the problem, the faster the response. We reply to every enquiry within two business days.
